## Filter contact form spam with a local Ollama model and email only real enquiries

For small businesses whose contact form inbox fills up with SEO pitches, link drops and scams. This workflow gives you a contact form, screens every message, and emails you only the ones from real people. You can reply straight from that email.

The spam check runs on your own machine through Ollama, so there is no AI bill and no message text goes to an AI company.

### How it works
1. A visitor fills in the n8n form (Name, Email, Message). Everyone sees the same thank-you text, so spammers learn nothing.
2. Plain rules run first. A link in the name field, or more links than max_links, marks the message as spam with no model call needed.
3. Ollama reads the message with a short description of your business and answers genuine or spam, with a reason.
4. Genuine messages are emailed to you with Reply-To set to the visitor. Spam stops at Spam Not Forwarded and stays visible in the execution log.
5. If the model answer cannot be read, the message is let through, so a model failure never drops a message.

### Setup
1. Install Ollama and pull a model, for example `ollama pull qwen2.5:3b`.
2. In **Set Filter Settings**, describe your business in one sentence and set notify_email and from_email.
3. Connect an SMTP credential on **Email Me The Enquiry**.
4. If n8n runs in Docker, set ollama_url to `http://host.docker.internal:11434`.
5. Activate the workflow and share the form's production URL, or link it from your website.

### Customization tips
Add your own phrases to spam_phrases. Swap the email node for Slack or Telegram if you prefer.

## Receive the form

The n8n form collects Name, Email and Message. Set Filter Settings holds everything you change.

## Screen the message

Rules catch link-stuffed spam. Ollama decides genuine or spam for the rest, using your business description.

## Forward real enquiries

Genuine messages are emailed to you with Reply-To set to the visitor. Spam is not forwarded.
